attempts.finding: The candidate tag, deterministic archive, archive attestation, complete asset set and platform immutability all passed on the first release attempt.

attempts.failure_step: Observe every rendered anchor and all three intent universes
attempts.finding: Three of 13,537 bulk link observations failed because the observer had no bounded retry and did not model HTTP 304 as reachable evidence.
attempts.correction: Add one bounded retry for network, 429 and 5xx outcomes, a 0.25-second backoff, HTTP 304 reachability, attempt counts and failure-artifact retention.

attempts.failure_step: Observe every explicitly protected rich page in genuine Chrome
attempts.finding: Chrome profile cleanup raced browser descendants and raised ENOTEMPTY; the finally-path could also mask any primary observation error.
attempts.correction: Treat signal exit as completion, wait after forced termination, retry profile removal, preserve the primary error and test the cleanup failure paths.

attempts.finding: The complete link closure, genuine-Chrome protected-page observations and three-engine journey passed, but the later promotion validator exposed receipt-contract mismatches that terminal generation had not checked.
attempts.correction: Validate the terminal artifact through the exact promotion contract before release and align receipt size, timestamp and browser-channel semantics.

attempts.failure_step: Validate R1-compatible R2 with trusted exact controls
attempts.finding: The promotion validator rejected the 11.5 MB link receipt under a generic 2 MiB control limit, millisecond-versus-microsecond journey timestamps, and a protected-browser channel label that differed from policy.
attempts.correction: Scope the larger bound to the exact link receipt, emit six-digit timestamps and use the policy channel genuine-google-chrome-cdp. No release was created.

attempts.finding: Terminal generation and semantic promotion validation passed with aligned timestamps, channel and receipt size handling.
attempts.correction: The subsequent release-policy phase revealed that its older loader independently reapplied the generic 2 MiB limit.

attempts.failure_step: Enforce same-commit tags and exact envelope attestation
attempts.finding: Semantic envelope validation and attestation passed, but release-policy revalidation used the older generic loader and rejected the link receipt as larger than 2 MiB.
attempts.correction: Route promotion release-policy validation through the same narrowly scoped terminal loader while retaining the 2 MiB default for every other control file. No release was created.

attempts.finding: All 13,548 canonical URLs, 11 protected pages and the 32-action three-engine journey passed with exact receipt cross-binding.
attempts.correction: No further terminal correction was required.

attempts.finding: R1 revalidation, terminal-envelope validation, envelope attestation, ten-asset closure, publication and platform immutability all passed.
attempts.correction: No further correction was required; the immutable release and its post-publication verification are the terminal state.
